about: More call time for a seat (decisions 0320 and 0305): a member asks for a length from the seat and the floor approves it, or the floor adds one. The length is one the club may offer: 15, 30, 45 minutes, 1 hour, 1 hour 30, 2, 3 or 4 hours (which of them a venue offers is its setting call_time.add_choices, checked apart from this rule). It is added whole to the later of the seat's call time and the whole minutes played, so time added after the call time is met runs from now. Only a seat with call time (more than nought minutes) can have more, and a call time is at most a day, 1,440 minutes, in all: anything that would pass it is refused, never cut down. Any other length is refused.

cases.description: An hour added to a three-hour call time makes four, two hours in.
Half an hour added to three hours, just seated.
Two hours added to five hours.
45 minutes, a length the club may offer, added to three hours.
Played exactly the call time: an hour from now makes four hours.
Met and played on: an hour after 3 h 40 played runs from now, 4 h 40 in all.
Met long ago: 15 minutes after ten hours played makes 10 h 15.
At the cap: an hour onto 23 hours makes exactly a day.
At the cap from time played: four hours after 20 hours played makes exactly a day.
Past the cap by a minute: half an hour onto 1,411 minutes is refused.
Past the cap from time played: an hour after 23 h 30 played is refused.
Zero: a seat with no call time has none to add to, however long played.
Not a choice: 50 minutes is refused.
Not a choice: nothing added is refused.
Not a choice: a negative length is refused, never taken off.
